newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares were mixed in reduced turnover on Monday on the Beirut Stock exchange.
A shares fell to $110 from Friday's $111.50 and B shares rose to $115.125 from $115.
Turnover fell to 7,700 shares from 10,361 on Friday, and value was $860,575 from $1,162,831.5.
Tthere was no trade in the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic. None the shares of the four companies were traded last week.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.18 percent to 83.88 and the BLOM stock index fell 0.47 percent to 962.39.
